rows.grounds: second-person pronoun addressed to the deity
compound: vibudha (gods) + āvāsa (abode, dwelling); vocative address
second-person pronoun addressed to the deity
compound: vibudha (gods) + priya (dear, beloved); vocative address

items.question: Which qualities of divine dwelling and belovedness among the gods warrant reverent homage?
premises: The deity is addressed as the abode of the gods.
The deity is addressed as dear to the gods.
Reverent homage is offered to the deity for these qualities.
items.inference: The deity merits homage as both the dwelling place and the beloved of the gods.
items.plain_english: Homage to you, abode of the gods; homage to you, dear to the gods.
